tokenizer_scope: The parent authorized the model directory named in the existing runner. Only config.json and tokenizer.json were read. No weights, pointer head, GPU or GPU lock were accessed for preregistration.

measurement_requirements: Use stock score_max unchanged: reset model state per branch, all tokens at position zero, one whole-branch bidirectional prefill, sample=false, no checkpoint, stock final_norm_row and stock head_.logits.

Capture the full active-option group immediately after head_.logits and before public-answer softmax/rounding. The measured width is exactly the active option count in its original order. Do not add unused readout rows or extra prompt options.

candidate_requirements: Compare baseline1||each candidate independently. Every branch must satisfy nonnegative KL gap <= exactly 2 * the committed global floor.

Do not round the gate, add epsilon, replace the gate with another metric, borrow a causal/LM floor, introduce a fallback, recalibrate the floor or relax the bound. A zero floor permits only zero nonnegative KL gap.

verification_python:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
p=json.loads(Path("tools/logit_floors/drex-max-v1.m5.protocol.json").read_text())
r=Path(p["request_file"])
l=Path(p["layout_file"])
assert hashlib.sha256(r.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==p["corpus_sha256"]
assert hashlib.sha256(l.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==p["layout_sha256"]
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(p["comparator_file"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==p["comparator_sha256"]
layout=json.loads(l.read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(layout["encoder_binary"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==layout["encoder_binary_sha256"]
for name,expected in p["model_metadata"].items():
    path=Path(p["model_dir"])/name
    assert path.stat().st_size==expected["bytes"]<50000000
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected["sha256"]
requests=json.loads(r.read_text())["requests"]
assert len(requests)==len(layout["layouts"])==len(p["branches"])==6
offset=0
for i,(body,expected) in enumerate(zip(requests,layout["layouts"])):
    assert expected["request_index"]==i
    result=subprocess.run(layout["encoder_argv"],input=json.dumps(body),text=True,capture_output=True,env=layout["encoder_environment"],timeout=30)
    assert result.returncode==0,(result.returncode,result.stderr)
    actual=json.loads(result.stdout[result.stdout.index("{"):])
    assert actual==expected["encoded"],expected["case"]
    assert len(actual["questions"])==1
    name,q=next(iter(actual["questions"].items()))
    branch=p["branches"][i]
    assert name==branch["question_id"]
    assert len(q["ids"])==q["tokens"]==branch["tokens"]<=p["context"]
    assert q["decide"]==branch["decide"]==q["tokens"]-1
    assert q["options"]==branch["option_indices"]==list(range(branch["width"]))
    assert q["keys"]==branch["option_keys"]==list(body["questions"][name]["criteria"])
    assert layout["rows"][i]=={"request_index":i,"branch_index":0,"question":{"id":name,"type":q["type"],"keys":q["keys"],"legend":q.get("legend",[])},"option_order":q["keys"],"tokens":q["ids"],"decide":q["decide"],"width":len(q["options"]),"byte_offset":offset}
    offset+=4*len(q["options"])
    print(i,name,q["tokens"],len(q["options"]),"CPU layout verified")
assert offset==layout["payload_bytes"]==72
print("PASS: frozen request, layout, metadata, comparator and encoder hashes; all six full layouts reproduced")
